ReportingProfile.title: ReportingProfile
ReportingProfile.description: Private, consent-based emergency fraud reporting preparation profile owned by a single verified user. Never stores OTPs, PINs, passwords, CVVs, Aadhaar, PAN, or full account/card numbers.

ownerId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the owning user.

consentGranted.description: Explicit user consent flag required before storing any profile fields.

fullName.description: Victim's optional full name for bank complaint prefill.

bankName.description: Optional bank or wallet provider name.

accountLast4.description: Last 4 digits of the affected account or card only.

scamDateTime.description: Approximate date and time of the incident.

scammerContact.description: Scammer phone number, UPI ID, or website.

shortDescription.description: Brief summary of what happened (no OTPs, PINs, CVVs, passwords, Aadhaar, or PAN).

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp updated on every modification.

/users/{userId}/private/{docId}.description: Strictly owner-isolated private reporting profile document (`docId == 'reportingProfile'`). Only readable, writable, and deletable by the verified owner (`request.auth.uid == userId`).
